svg.aria-label: Left: an 8 by 8 color image. Rows 0 and 1 are sky blue, rows 6 and 7 are brown ground, and rows 2 to 5 hold a red-brown house in columns 2 to 5 between green hill pixels in columns 0, 1, 6 and 7. Right: the gray levels of the same pixels: 144 for the sky, 112 for the hill, 120 for the house and 96 for the ground. Below, the 4 colors: sky (120, 150, 180) gives (36,960 + 128) >> 8 = 144; hill (70, 140, 80) gives 112; house (170, 100, 90) gives 120; ground (120, 90, 60) gives 96. Each color covers 16 pixels.
svg.text: An 8 x 8 image of 4 colors, 16 pixels each, and its gray levels.
